_how_to_use: Write a genre for any artist, like "midwest emo", or a list like ["emo", "math rock"]; the first one decides the song's group.
What you write here always wins over MusicBrainz and Last.fm, so you can also add any other artist to fix a genre the databases got wrong.
Groups go by words in the genre: emo, emo rap / cloud rap, post-hardcore / metal / screamo, punk, hip hop / rap / trap, r&b / soul, indie / alternative, rock, pop / electronic.
Leave "" for artists you don't want to set. Artists left blank are looked up on Last.fm by lastfm_genres.py.
